name: Kevin's Legit GitHub Sideload
subtitle: Open-source + tweaked IPAs — every IPA from GitHub Releases
description: Curated Sidestore/AltStore source — 11 open-source classics + 5 newer picks (SwiftUI & tweaked value apps). Every downloadURL points straight to the upstream GitHub Release asset (16 verified HEAD 200 on 2026-08-08). Add via Sidestore: Settings > Sources > Add Source > https://kb01111.github.io/Sideload-Sources/source.json

apps.name: Delta
apps.subtitle: All-in-one retro emulator (NES/SNES/N64/GBA/DS)
apps.localizedDescription: Delta is the official open-source successor to GBA4iOS. Supports NES, SNES, N64, Game Boy, Game Boy Advance and Nintendo DS with controller skins, save states, cheats and AirPlay. AGPL-3.0 licensed. Direct GitHub release — no patches.
apps.versionDescription: iPad support, brand new icon, melonDS 0.9.5, menu-button gestures. See https://github.com/RileyTestut/Delta/releases/tag/v1.6

versions.localizedDescription: iPad support, Handoff, melonDS 0.9.5, menu gestures. Full notes: https://github.com/RileyTestut/Delta/releases/tag/v1.6

apps.name: Provenance
apps.subtitle: Multi-system emulator frontend for iOS/tvOS
apps.localizedDescription: The most complete iOS/tvOS frontend - Atari, Bandai, NEC, Nintendo, Sega, SNK and Sony systems via one app. Supports 3.3.0 with iCloud sync, revamped tvOS UI, video filters. Build config: org.provenance-emu.provenance. Wiki: https://wiki.provenance-emu.com
apps.versionDescription: Biggest release in 4 months: iCloud sync, tvOS redesign, video filters + core stability. https://github.com/Provenance-Emu/Provenance/releases/tag/3.3.0

versions.localizedDescription: iCloud sync, new tvOS interface, video filters. See release notes on GitHub.

apps.name: UTM
apps.subtitle: Virtual machines for iOS & macOS (QEMU)
apps.localizedDescription: Run Windows, Linux and more in VMs on iOS. Full QEMU backend with JIT via AltJIT/StikDebug. Apache-2.0. The 4.7.5 IPA is the HV version (requires JIT). For non-JIT devices use UTM SE below. 34k+ stars.
apps.versionDescription: UTM 4.7.5 - includes UTM.ipa (HV), UTM-SE variants and visionOS builds. https://github.com/utmapp/UTM/releases/tag/v4.7.5

versions.localizedDescription: Full UTM with hypervisor/JIT. Requires JIT enabler (StikDebug/LiveContainer) on non-jailbroken devices.

apps.name: UTM SE
apps.subtitle: UTM Slow Edition — no JIT required, App Store compliant
apps.localizedDescription: UTM SE is the App Store-compliant build that runs without JIT/hypervisor - slower but works without a JIT enabler. Ideal for sideloading if you don't want to manage JIT. Same 4.7.5 release as UTM.
apps.versionDescription: SE variant of 4.7.5 for devices without JIT. https://github.com/utmapp/UTM/releases/tag/v4.7.5

versions.localizedDescription: Slow Edition - runs without JIT. Use this if you don't have StikDebug/JIT.

apps.name: PPSSPP
apps.subtitle: PSP emulator (iOS, Android, Desktop)
apps.localizedDescription: The premiere PSP emulator - play your PSP ISOs on iOS with Vulkan/Metal, save states, networking and cheats. GPL-2.0+. Bundle ID org.ppsspp.ppsspp-free verified from ios/PPSSPP-Info.plist. 1.20.4 is latest iOS IPA.

apps.name: iTorrent
apps.subtitle: Torrent client for iOS 16+
apps.localizedDescription: Native Swift torrent client with Files integration, magnet links, background downloads, RSS and media player. MIT licensed. Bundle com.xitrix.iTorrent2 (APPLICATION_ID). Active development, 3.1k stars.

versions.localizedDescription: Torrent client for iOS 16+ with background downloading.

apps.name: Feather
apps.subtitle: On-device IPA signer & installer
apps.localizedDescription: Free on-device iOS app manager/installer using Apple Developer certificates - sign and install IPAs without a computer. GPL-3.0. Bundle thewonderofyou.Feather. Icon and repo via khcrysalis/Feather, IPA hosted at declration/Feather (official mirror).
apps.versionDescription: Feather 2.9.0 - https://github.com/khcrysalis/Feather releases (IPA via declration mirror)

versions.localizedDescription: On-device signing - import certs and install IPAs directly on iPhone.

apps.name: LiveContainer
apps.subtitle: Run iOS apps without installing them
apps.localizedDescription: Launch unsigned iOS apps in a container without actually installing them. Requires SideStore 0.6.2+ or AltStore 2.2.1+. Also available as LiveContainer+SideStore bundle. AGPL-3.0. 10k+ stars.
apps.versionDescription: 3.8.0 - standalone requires SideStore/AltStore. Use LiveContainer+SideStore.ipa with Impactor/iloader if standalone fails. https://github.com/LiveContainer/LiveContainer/releases/tag/3.8.0

apps.name: SideStore
apps.subtitle: AltStore fork - no AltServer required
apps.localizedDescription: Community fork of AltStore that refreshes apps on-device via WireGuard/idevice pairing. AGPL-3.0. Use with LiveContainer or as your daily sidestore. Latest 0.6.3 fixes VPN on iOS 26.4+ (reinstall via iloader advised).

apps.name: iSH
apps.subtitle: Linux shell on iOS - Alpine via usermode x86 emulation
apps.localizedDescription: Run a full Alpine Linux shell on iOS - apk, python, git, ssh and more via lightning-fast usermode x86 emulation. No jailbreak. ROOT_BUNDLE_IDENTIFIER app.ish.iSH. Latest IPA builds/494 (2023 stable). Local iSH appstore available.

versions.localizedDescription: Linux shell for iOS - run Alpine packages on iPhone/iPad.

apps.name: StikDebug
apps.subtitle: On-device debugger & JIT enabler for iOS 17.4+
apps.localizedDescription: Enable JIT for UTM/Provenance/Delta without a Mac/PC via idevice pairing. Required companion for UTM HV and many emulators on iOS 17.4+. AGPL-3.0. Uses the SideStore pairing flow.

versions.localizedDescription: JIT enabler for iOS 17.4+ - pair once, enable JIT for any app.

apps.name: Spotube
apps.subtitle: Open-source Spotify client — no premium needed (SwiftUI/Flutter)
apps.localizedDescription: Spotube is a lightweight, privacy-friendly Spotify frontend that streams from YouTube Music / Piped — no Spotify premium required. SwiftUI/Flutter codebase, GPL-3.0 friendly, 48k+ stars. This iOS IPA is the official GitHub Release (Spotube-iOS.ipa). Newest value pick for 2026.

versions.localizedDescription: Open-source Spotify client with YouTube/Piped backend. No account needed.

apps.name: BHTwitter
apps.subtitle: Tweaked Twitter/X — ad block, download, premium unlock (tweaked)
apps.localizedDescription: BHTwitter is the most complete Twitter/X tweak: block ads & promoted tweets, download videos/images, hide trends, unlock premium features and custom themes. Injected into a decrypted Twitter IPA — sideloaded variant keeps original bundle com.atebits.Tweetie2 so it replaces the App Store app. Also available as BHTwitter-trollstore.tipa. v4.4 (2025-05-13).
apps.versionDescription: BHTwitter 4.4 sideloaded. https://github.com/BandarHL/BHTwitter/releases/tag/4.4 — also has trollstore.tipa + debs.

versions.localizedDescription: Tweaked Twitter with ad-block, media downloads and premium unlock.

apps.name: PojavLauncher
apps.subtitle: Minecraft: Java Edition on iOS (Swift/ObjC + Java)
apps.localizedDescription: Run Minecraft Java Edition natively on iOS — full Java runtime, mod & Fabric/Forge support, touch controls and controller. GPL-3.0. Successor Amethyst-iOS is in dev, but this 2.2 IPA (2023-05-06) remains the last stable sideloadable build and still brings unique value. Requires JIT for best performance (pair with StikDebug).
apps.versionDescription: PojavLauncher iOS v2.2 — Minecraft Java on iOS. https://github.com/PojavLauncherTeam/PojavLauncher_iOS/releases/tag/v2.2

versions.localizedDescription: Minecraft Java Edition launcher for iOS — mods, shaders, multiplayer.

apps.name: LBox
apps.subtitle: SwiftUI repo manager for LiveContainer (NEW 2025)
apps.localizedDescription: LBox is a native SwiftUI companion for LiveContainer — browse public sources, search and download IPAs, and install/launch apps directly on device with seamless LiveContainer integration. MIT, fully SwiftUI, newest value app on the source (v1.2 — 2025-12-08). Perfect pairing with LiveContainer + SideStore.
apps.versionDescription: LBox v1.2 — SwiftUI LiveContainer source browser. https://github.com/Lolendor/LBox/releases/tag/v1.2

versions.localizedDescription: SwiftUI repository manager for LiveContainer — browse, download and launch IPAs.

apps.name: Apollo (Patched)
apps.subtitle: Reddit's Apollo — revived with custom API key (tweaked)
apps.localizedDescription: Apollo was sunset in 2023 — ApolloPatcher revives it by patching your own Reddit API key at runtime. This sideloaded IPA (Apollo 1.15.11 patched with 0.1.0) restores the best Reddit client on iOS. GPL-3.0, fully open patcher. You supply your own client ID/secret in settings. For fans of the classic Apollo experience.
apps.versionDescription: ApolloPatched v0.1.0 — Apollo 1.15.11 with custom API key support. https://github.com/ichitaso/ApolloPatcher/releases/tag/v0.1.0

versions.localizedDescription: Revived Apollo with configurable Reddit API key — bring your own credentials.

news.title: Update: 5 new SwiftUI + tweaked picks added!
news.caption: NEW: Spotube (open Spotify client), BHTwitter (tweaked X), PojavLauncher (Minecraft Java), LBox (SwiftUI LiveContainer manager) and Apollo Patched (revived Reddit). All are official GitHub Release IPAs — tap to update/pull-to-refresh Sources. No local builds required.

news.title: Welcome to Kevin's Legit Source
news.caption: Core 11 are 100% open-source; new 5 are vetted tweaked/SwiftUI value apps. Every IPA links straight to its upstream GitHub Release — no repacks, no ads. If an app vanishes, check the linked GitHub tag for a newer IPA.

news.title: How to add this source to Sidestore
news.caption: Sidestore: Settings > Sources > Add Source > paste https://kb01111.github.io/Sideload-Sources/source.json . AltStore: Sources > + > same URL. Or tap the link at https://kb01111.github.io/Sideload-Sources/ on your iPhone.

news.title: Why these 16? Criteria & exclusions
news.caption: All 16 have a tagged GitHub Release with an IPA asset. Core = OSI license + no piracy. New 5 = open patcher/SwiftUI value where the published IPA is the project's official artifact (BHTwitter-sideloaded, ApolloPatcher, etc.). Excluded: uYou+/Enhanced, YTLitePlus, EeveeSpotify (451) — they publish no Release IPA artifact.
